description: MotelMoose helps hotel operators inspect their connected ASI hotels, discover available reporting data, query stored records, and retrieve approved live reports. Its companion skill guides reporting definitions, date comparisons, and missing-data handling. It cannot change reservations, rates, or payments. Live reads save snapshots and operational diagnostics are recorded. Optional beta sharing can retain related question wording, redacted tool arguments, and draft answer excerpts according to the account setting. A MotelMoose account with access to the relevant hotel is required.

defaultPrompt: Show my hotels and when their data was last updated.
What reporting dates and hotel datasets are available?
Answer the suggested question for my hotel using verified imported data.
